title: Report cost per output
description:
I want to know which checklist item costs what.

Current: usage() aggregates by model and window only (embedded_cyclotron.py:600-640); batched answers count usage once (classifier_config.py:15-21).

Desired: an estimated share of request bytes/tokens per output plus optimizer cost per output.

Acceptance: usage includes a per-output breakdown labeled as an estimate; per-output totals sum to the cyclotron total.
